summary.one_liner: A curated Markdown list of command-line shells, frameworks, productivity tools, prompts, guides and games for the terminal.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome" list, not software: a long categorized index of links and one-line descriptions for shell-related projects. Sections cover alternative shells (bash, zsh, fish, nushell, xonsh and others), command-line productivity tools (search, history, bookmarks, multiplexers, file managers), directory navigation tools, prompt and color customization, developer tools for git and deployment, system utilities, downloading and serving tools, multimedia and file format tools, applications, shell games, shell package and dotfile managers, and shell script development frameworks and testing tools. A final section links to general shell guides and reference manuals, and another points to related awesome lists such as awesome-zsh, awesome-fish and awesome-bash. Entries are mostly plain names with short descriptions and do not include install instructions or version details.
use_cases: Finding a shell or prompt to try
Choosing a dotfiles or shell plugin manager
Finding shell script testing and CLI framework options
Browsing shell learning guides and references
Locating directory navigation tools like autojump or zoxide
notable: Organized by topic with a short description for each tool, covering shells through to shell games
Separate awesome-zsh, awesome-fish and awesome-bash companion lists are linked from the main list
Includes a guides section linking to the Bash reference manual, Bash Hackers Wiki and Google's Shell Style Guide
Also published on Unix-Shell.ZEEF.com according to the README
caveats: It is an index of links only; the README does not verify that listed projects are maintained or current
Entries are one-line descriptions with no install or comparison detail
Platform support for listed tools varies and is not stated in the list
